g.text: the same colours mean the same things on every page
titles, frameworks and their structure (CIRCLES steps, Porter's forces)
process steps, flows, actions over time (journeys, rollouts, pipelines)
good outcome, success metric, the chosen option, a pass
risk, failure, pain point, guardrail breach, a rejected option
the highlighted number, key insight or answer
data, models and AI system parts (LLM, retriever, eval set, embeddings)
